title: Commons: Single-clock world-time display, read_chat sent_ago, and optional advance-clock toggle
goal: Keep The Commons strictly on the single world.time_ticks clock while supporting standalone texting sessions via an optional clock-advance toggle

sections.what: Align Commons UI timestamps, read_chat message ages, and auto-timer gating with world.time_ticks, plus add an optional Advance world clock on reply toggle.
sections.why: Commons UI previously showed real-world wall-clock time while world.time_ticks stayed frozen, causing the LLM to hallucinate 'four days' of silence and spam unreturned messages.
sections.how: Include world clock metadata in /api/commons/state, format message.tick in commons-ui.ts, attach sent_time and sent_ago in read_chat, guard auto-timers against 0-unread/0-elapsed-tick spam, and add commonsAdvanceClockOnReply toggle.
sections.verify: pytest tests/test_commons.py -q and npm run build:ts

acceptance.text: Commons UI message bubbles format timestamps from message.tick into world time (Day D, HH:MM) matching the single world clock
read_chat returns sent_time and sent_ago on every message computed from world.time_ticks - message.tick
Unprompted auto-timers skip waking characters when there are zero unread messages and zero elapsed world ticks
Optional 'Advance world clock on reply' toggle (off by default) advances world.time_ticks by 1 per posted Commons message when enabled

custom.browser_ui: In /commons, messages show world time (e.g. Day 1, 08:05) instead of local wall-clock time; Characters & pacing includes an 'Advance world clock on reply' checkbox (off by default).
